In any case, if the vehicle met with an accident, any loss or damage made to the vehicl e because of any reason will be completely worn by the contractor and this office has no liability for the same. 10. The vehicles provided by the contractor will be made available on all days including ho lidays on round the clock basis. The service provider shall provide replacement of vehicle within one hour in case of br eakdown or servicing. In case replacement is not provided, the Income Tax Departmen t will book similar vehicle from alternative sources and the expenses so incurred will be recovered from the monthly bill. 12. The service provider shall make regular, timely and full payment of labour charges, salaries and o ther payments as due, as per the labour laws or any other laws to its personnel deputed under th e contract. 13. The service provider shall be solely responsible for any/all disputes between him and the driver d eployed by him. The Department will not entertain any such dispute and there should be no clai m or liability against the office of the Commissioner of Income Tax(TDS)-2, Chandigarh or any of it s officers on this account. The service provider will keep the office of the Commissioner of Income Tax(TDS)-2, Chandigarh indemnified against all actions. 14. The contractor/service provider should specifically note that the engagement of the service provid er under this contract does not in any way confer any right on the Service Provider or the persons that may be deployed by him in this office, for claiming any regular employment in this office or any other Government Office. The service provider should also obtain a written undertaking from the persons deployed by him to work in this office that they are fully aware that their deploymen t to work in this office does not confer any right on them for claiming any regular employment in this office or any other Government Office. Attested copies of such undertaking have to be submi tted to the Department at the time of signing of Contract. 15. The vehicle provided to the Department should only be in white colour. The driver to be provided by the contractor with the vehicle will be in uniform (White Pants, White Shirt and Black Shoes) w hile on duty as per guidelines of RTO. Following conditions are also to be fulfilled by the contracto r/driver:- a) The driver will have a valid driving license and experience of more than three years of driving the class of vehicle offered for hire. b) The driver will be provided with a mobile phone by the contractor. The bill of the mobile phon e is to be borne by the contractor. The driver should always be reachable on mobile phone du ring the period of his deployment. c) The driver should be decent and well behaved. He should not have any criminal background. I t shall be the responsibility of the Contractor to verify the antecedents of the driver before de ployment. d) The contractor will be responsible for Police verification & verification of medical fitness and s uitability of driver before deployment. e) The driver will have knowledge of city routes and should be able to communicate both in Hind

i and English. f) All statutory compliance related to employment of the driver will be adhered by the contracto r. g) Dedicated driver will be provided to the Department. Any change would be permitted only in exceptional circumstances, on prior permission. 18. The personal deployed by the contractor will maintain decency, peace and order during deployme nt with the department. He will behave courteously with all the officers/employees of the depart ment, other personnel working for the department and the visitors of the office/ residential premi ses. The driver/personnel would be required to be immediately replaced by the contractor on co mplaint of misbehaviour. Any damage to property by the deployed personnel shall be recovered f rom the contractor. 19. The vehicle registered as Public Service Vehicle (Commercial Vehicle) with the competent authorit ies of the State Government will be given preference. 20. The vehicle is to be maintained in excellent condition and regular cleaning must be ensured. 21. A daily record indicating time and mileage for each vehicle will be maintained in a logbook and e ntries therein must be certified by the user. 22. The vehicle taken on hire would have to be parked either in the office premises or at the premises of the officer to whom the vehicle is allotted/or at his/ her discretion. 23.
